## 8.1 实施子会话的执行事实

本报告的事实基础由**两个实施子会话**（同一 session id `01a16f88-89cb-7781-825e-f385000bd08d`，
MiniMax 单任务 override）共同构成，逐段事实如下（VERIFIED_BY_RUN；账本见 `commands.json` 与 `model_usage.json`）：

| 项 | attempt-1 | attempt-2 |
|---|---|---|
| exit code | **1** | **0** |
| wall | **600.288 s**（被 `--max-time 10m` 在 600.3 s 处停止） | **357.9 s**（账本精确值 357.852 s） |
| 写入文件 | 仅 `config/inference/hist_vnext_v1/failed_seeds.json` | `config/inference/hist_vnext_v1/REPORT.md`、`config/inference/hist_vnext_v1/BLOCKER_CERTIFICATE.json` |
| session id | `01a16f88-89cb-7781-825e-f385000bd08d` | 同一 `01a16f88-89cb-7781-825e-f385000bd08d`（在同一 session id 上恢复） |
| model / provider | `minimax-code-cn` / `MiniMax-M3` | 同一 `minimax-code-cn` / `MiniMax-M3`（未换模型、未换 provider、未 fallback） |
| 范围变更 | 无 | 无（同一白名单、同一合同、同一结论方向；仅恢复被 timeout 中断的同一任务） |

- attempt-1 的停止是**真实故障**，按合同"进程超时…都STOP，保存反证"保留在证据包中，不改写为正常结束，
  也不以"重试"抹去（VERIFIED_BY_RUN；`commands.json` 的 `implementation.attempt-1` note 与
  `model_usage.json` 的 `executor_sessions[0].outcome`）。
- 恢复方式依据 `06_OMP_MINIMAX_HANDOFF.md:19`"采用小样本profile、分批/可恢复运行和必要的技术timeout"：
  在同一 session id 上启动新的 10m 有界进程，而非延长原进程（VERIFIED_BY_CODE）。
- **溯源合并披露**：attempt-2 的提示词明确要求**不再做新的调查**（只按前序调查结论落笔写文件），
  因此本报告的事实性引用（合同逐字摘录、行号核对、p05 的 15 项识别身份、H1/H4/H5 前置记录与各 review 的实际
  verdict/scope、命令与日志路径）**主要继承 attempt-1 的调查上下文**；attempt-2 承担的是这些既有事实的成文、
  证书编制与最终逐字/逐哈希核验（VERIFIED_BY_RUN）。
- 本报告与证书随后由 review 修复轮在同一白名单内修订；该修订只改溯源与措辞字段，不改任何科学结论
  （status / blocking_code / identifiable_set / inference_status / 三维状态 / 15 项参数身份 / NOT_RUN 清单均不变）。

import json, hashlib, os, re
root="/Users/wahrfreiheit/OMP/hungary-socialist-mechanism-lab"; os.chdir(root)
cert=json.load(open("config/inference/hist_vnext_v1/BLOCKER_CERTIFICATE.json",encoding="utf-8"))
rep=open("config/inference/hist_vnext_v1/REPORT.md",encoding="utf-8").read()
seeds=json.load(open("config/inference/hist_vnext_v1/failed_seeds.json",encoding="utf-8"))
ct=json.dumps(cert,ensure_ascii=False); fails=[]
def chk(c,m):
    if not c: fails.append(m)
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest()

# scientific conclusions frozen
chk(cert["status"]=="BLOCKED" and cert["blocking_code"]=="MISSING_INDEPENDENT_LINKAGE_ADMISSION","core")
chk(cert["identifiable_set"]==[] and cert["inference_status"]=="NOT_RUN","set")
chk([cert["dimensions"][k]["status"] for k in ("technical","structural","historical")]==["BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE","NOT_RUN","UNIDENTIFIED"],"dims")
ident=json.load(open("config/calibration/p05.json",encoding="utf-8"))["identification"]
for p in cert["parameter_typing"]["parameters"]:
    chk(p["identification"]==ident[p["artifact_id"]],"ident"); chk(p["historical_estimate"] is False,"hist")
chk(cert["parameter_typing"]["counts"]=={"fixed":9,"unidentified":6,"total":15},"counts")
chk(len(cert["not_executed"])==12,"not_executed")
chk(seeds["status"]=="NOT_RUN" and seeds["seeds"]==[],"seeds")

# D2
ex=cert["executor"]
chk(ex["session"].startswith("implementation session attempt-2"),"D2 session")
chk("01a16f88-89cb-7781-825e-f385000bd08d" in ex["session"],"D2 sid")
chk("implementation.attempt-2.jsonl" in ex["actual_source"] and "implementation.attempt-1.jsonl" in ex["actual_source"],"D2 src")
a1,a2=ex["attempts"]
chk(a1["exit_code"]==1 and a1["wall_seconds"]==600.288,"D2 a1"); chk(a2["exit_code"]==0 and a2["wall_seconds"]==357.9,"D2 a2")
chk(a1["session_id"]==a2["session_id"]=="01a16f88-89cb-7781-825e-f385000bd08d","D2 sameid")
chk(cert["created_utc"]=="2026-10-24T20:25:44Z","D2 created"); chk(cert["written_by_attempt"]=="implementation.attempt-2","D2 wba")

# D3
chk("无真实进程故障" not in rep and "本轮**无**真实进程故障" not in rep,"D3 removed")
chk("无 timeout / OOM / 磁盘不足 / 信号" in rep,"D3 probe scope")
chk("600.288 s" in rep and "attempt-2，exit 0，wall 357.9 s" in rep,"D3 both facts")
chk("小样本profile、分批/可恢复运行和必要的技术timeout" in rep,"D3 basis")

# D4
chk("## 8.1 实施子会话的执行事实" in rep,"D4 sec")
tbl=rep.split("## 8.1 实施子会话的执行事实")[1].split("## 9.")[0]
for tok in ["600.288 s","357.9 s","failed_seeds.json","REPORT.md","BLOCKER_CERTIFICATE.json","01a16f88-89cb-7781-825e-f385000bd08d","minimax-code-cn","MiniMax-M3","范围变更"]:
    chk(tok in tbl, f"D4 table missing {tok}")
chk("不再做新的调查" in tbl and "继承 attempt-1 的调查上下文" in tbl,"D4 disclosure")
chk("两个实施子会话合计写出" in rep and "两个实施子会话合计**未**写" in rep,"D4 s10")
chk("本子会话" not in rep,"D4 old wording gone")

# D5
chk("PLAN 前置清点记 23 个未跟踪路径" in rep and "执行起始快照为 24 条" in rep and "非用户工作丢失或新增" in rep,"D5")

# D6
chk("行 13–17（维度表）、行 20（H5E 未完成声明）" in rep,"D6 m07")
chk("会话仅对 `data/manifests/` 做过一次目录列举（不含载荷内容）" in rep,"D6 manifests")
chk("未打开目标 registry、holdout registry 与封存/保留载荷" in rep,"D6 scope")

# integrity
def lines(p): return open(p,encoding="utf-8").read().split("\n")
for rc in cert["required_contract"]:
    L=lines(rc["path"])
    for q in rc["quote"]: chk(q in L, f"QUOTE {rc['path']}: {q[:40]}")
n=0
def walk(o):
    global n
    if isinstance(o,dict):
        p=o.get("path")
        if isinstance(p,str) and os.path.exists(p):
            for hk,bk in (("sha256","bytes"),("stdout_sha256","stdout_bytes")):
                if isinstance(o.get(hk),str):
                    n+=1; chk(sha(p)==o[hk], f"HASH {p}")
                    if isinstance(o.get(bk),int): chk(os.path.getsize(p)==o[bk], f"BYTES {p}")
        for v in o.values(): walk(v)
    elif isinstance(o,list):
        for v in o: walk(v)
walk(cert)
for p,h in {"BASELINE.md":"1f5b233f452468701ca2d87b3ec032be4654b070ed24e5853232c997d7d61b6f",
            "config/research_contract.json":"6f54522a4b9577fc8e75cb605b0cbfafddd62a9f6b8b474719f8996ada752c82",
            "uv.lock":"9fd79b625bed399c5231e1f51b478ebf375154132a30dd9538191156218882b9",
            "config/calibration/p05.json":"ef1371b66625ddaf78663cc1181679443d7288c084c18f54e1b206a5470bb6ae"}.items():
    chk(sha(p)==h, f"DRIFT {p}")
chk(sha("config/inference/hist_vnext_v1/commands.json") not in ct and sha("config/inference/hist_vnext_v1/commands.json") not in rep,"commands hash")
chk("rank=0" not in ct and "rank=0" not in rep,"no zero-rank token")

print("hash/bytes pairs verified:", n)
print("FAILS:", fails if fails else "NONE")
for f in ["REPORT.md","BLOCKER_CERTIFICATE.json","failed_seeds.json"]:
    p=f"config/inference/hist_vnext_v1/{f}"
    print(f"{f}: {os.path.getsize(p)} B  sha256={sha(p)}")
